import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from xgboost import XGBClassifier
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
import os

# Set random seeds for reproducibility
np.random.seed(42)

# Check input directory
input_dir = "./input"
if not os.path.exists(input_dir):
    input_dir = "input"

print("Loading datasets...")
train_df = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(input_dir, "train.csv"))
test_df = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(input_dir, "test.csv"))
sample_submission = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(input_dir, "sample_submission.csv"))

print(f"Train shape: {train_df.shape}, Test shape: {test_df.shape}")

# Extract target columns
target_cols = ["toxic", "severe_toxic", "obscene", "threat", "insult", "identity_hate"]

# Hold out 20% for validation (this split will NEVER be used for training final model)
val_mask = train_df["id"].notna()
val_ratio = 0.8
train_indices, val_indices = train_test_split(
    train_df.index.tolist(),
    test_size=1 - val_ratio,
    stratify=train_df[target_cols].values if val_ratio < 1 else None,
    random_state=42,
)

# Split targets
y_train = train_df.loc[train_indices, target_cols]
y_val = train_df.loc[val_indices, target_cols]

# Combine texts
texts_train = train_df.loc[train_indices, "comment_text"].tolist()
texts_val = train_df.loc[val_indices, "comment_text"].tolist()
texts_test = test_df["comment_text"].tolist()

print(f"Training samples: {len(texts_train)}, Validation samples: {len(texts_val)}")

# TF-IDF Vectorization with reasonable parameters for this task
vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
    max_features=50000, ngram_range=(1, 2), min_df=2, max_df=0.95, sublinear_tf=True
)

# Fit transformer on combined train+val data (NOT test)
combined_texts = texts_train + texts_val
vectorizer.fit(combined_texts)

# Transform data
X_train_tfidf = vectorizer.transform(texts_train).todense()
X_val_tfidf = vectorizer.transform(texts_val).todense()
X_test_tfidf = vectorizer.transform(texts_test).todense()

print(f"TF-IDF Feature count: {X_train_tfidf.shape[1]}")

# Train XGBoost model for each toxicity type
models = {}
all_train_scores = []
all_val_scores = []

for col in target_cols:
    model = XGBClassifier(
        n_estimators=100,
        max_depth=6,
        learning_rate=0.1,
        subsample=0.8,
        colsample_bytree=0.8,
        eval_metric="auc",
        use_label_encoder=False,
        random_state=42,
        verbosity=0,
        n_jobs=-1,
    )

    # Split into train and val for this loop
    train_data, val_data = X_train_tfidf.copy(), X_val_tfidf.copy()
    y_train_col = y_train[col].values.astype(np.float64)
    y_val_col = y_val[col].values.astype(np.float64)

    model.fit(train_data, y_train_col, verbose=False)

    # Predictions on hold-out validation set (NEVER seen during final training)
    val_pred_prob = model.predict_proba(val_data)[:, 1]
    val_auc = roc_auc_score(y_val_col, val_pred_prob)
    all_val_scores.append(val_auc)
    print(f"{col}: Validation AUC = {val_auc:.6f}")

    # Store for final test predictions
    models[col] = model

    # Make test predictions
    test_pred_prob = model.predict_proba(X_test_tfidf)[:, 1]
    all_train_scores.append(test_pred_prob)

# Create submission dataframe
print("\nGenerating submission file...")
ids = test_df["id"].values
predictions = [all_train_scores[i] for i in range(len(target_cols))]
submission_df = pd.DataFrame(
    {"id": ids, **{col: pred for col, pred in zip(target_cols, predictions)}}
)

# Ensure submission directory exists
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)

# Save submission with correct order matching sample_submission
submission_columns = ["id"] + target_cols
submission_df = submission_df[submission_columns]
submission_df.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)

print(f"\nSubmission saved to ./submission/submission.csv")
print(f"\n--- VALIDATION COLUMN-WISE ROC AUC SCORES ---")
print(f"Mean AUC: {sum(all_val_scores)/len(all_val_scores):.6f}")
for col, auc in zip(target_cols, all_val_scores):
    print(f"{col}: {auc:.6f}")
